standard_prerequisites.name: For an element of a field not lying in a subring there is a valuation ring of the field containing the subring and not containing that element
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the family of valuation rings whose product is built in the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: A product of rings of weak dimension at most one has weak dimension at most one, and the same holds for the ring appearing as the product of the fields
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the weak dimension statement for the constructed ring, in both of the forms the statement asks about.

core_obligations: For every element x of the field outside the given subring choose a valuation ring V_x containing the subring and missing x, using the existence statement for valuation rings (proof lines 30692-30693).
Form the product V of the V_x indexed by those elements and the product L of copies of the field, and observe that V sits inside L (proof lines 30694-30695).
Apply the weak dimension statement for products to conclude that V has weak dimension at most one, and that the same holds for L (proof lines 30695-30697).

Check the remaining properties claimed in the statement: the inclusion of the subring into V and the identification of the relevant localization, which follow from the way the factors were chosen (proof lines 30698-30703).
proof_roadmap: Choose one valuation ring per element outside the subring and take the product (proof lines 30692-30695).
Apply the product statement for weak dimension (proof lines 30695-30697).
Verify the containment and localization claims from the construction (proof lines 30698-30703).
difficulty_reason: 证明 12 行，但是**构造性**的：对域中每个不在子环里的元素各取一个含子环而不含该元素的赋值环，把这些赋值环乘起来得到 V（再取域本身的乘积 L），然后用「弱维数 ≤1 对乘积封闭」得到维数结论，最后核对包含与局部化。构件与三条核验都写在 span 内；2 处同章引用作桩。
